description: This Java class, IniFileReader, provides utility methods for reading and parsing INI configuration files. It includes functions for tokenizing lines and reading files into a RawIniFile structure.

classes.name: RawIniFile
classes.description: A class representing the raw structure of an INI file, including its lines. Used internally by IniFileReader to store parsed lines.

methods.name: splitTokens
methods.description: Splits a line into tokens, considering quotes and separators. Handles key-value syntax with optional quotation marks.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads an InputStream or File into a RawIniFile object, skipping comment and empty lines.
